Pilot at one warehouse (Weeks 1–10), 2-week parallel run against the existing spreadsheets, then the remaining 5 sites in two batches (Weeks 13–24).

suggested_fixes.title: Contradicts no-migration constraint
suggested_fixes.original_quote: we recommend migrating away from your current PostgreSQL database to our proprietary cloud data platform for best performance and scalability.
suggested_fixes.replacement: we will integrate directly with your existing PostgreSQL database via a read-only connector — no migration or schema changes, as required by the RFP.
suggested_fixes.reason: RFP §3 explicitly forbids migrating to a new database.

suggested_fixes.title: Unrealistic 8-week promise
suggested_fixes.original_quote: within 8 weeks, well ahead of typical industry timelines.
suggested_fixes.replacement: with a working pilot at one warehouse within 3 months and full rollout to all 6 sites within 6 months, in line with your stated timeline.
suggested_fixes.reason: RFP requires a pilot gate at 3 months and rollout by 6.

suggested_fixes.title: Scope creep
suggested_fixes.original_quote: combining real-time inventory visibility with predictive demand forecasting, automated reorder recommendations, supplier performance scoring, and a complete migration to a modern cloud-native data platform for maximum performance.
suggested_fixes.replacement: focused on real-time inventory visibility, configurable low-stock alerts and role-based access as requested; demand forecasting and supplier scoring are offered as optional Phase-2 add-ons, priced separately.
suggested_fixes.reason: Requested scope is a dashboard, alerts, roles, rollout, support.

suggested_fixes.title: Roles and alert routing missing
suggested_fixes.original_quote: Real-time alerts across all locations simultaneously.
suggested_fixes.replacement: Role-based access — warehouse managers see only their own site, HQ staff see all 6 — and automated low-stock alerts to the responsible manager when an item falls below a configurable per-item threshold.
suggested_fixes.reason: RFP §2 and §4 define thresholds and roles.

suggested_fixes.title: No risks disclosed
suggested_fixes.original_quote: Vantix specializes in cutting-edge AI transformation and is excited to bring the full power of modern machine learning and cloud infrastructure to NordFrame Logistics.
suggested_fixes.replacement:
Vantix has delivered inventory dashboards on existing PostgreSQL estates for logistics operators and will apply that experience to NordFrame's 6-site footprint.

## Risks & Assumptions
- Assumes read-only access to the existing PostgreSQL database.
- Phased rollout assumes one point-of-contact per warehouse; delays shift later phases.
- Optional analytics modules depend on 6+ months of historical data quality.
suggested_fixes.reason: RFP §7 requires documented risks; the current draft has none.
